Common questions

Answers without the extra spice

What is momo achar masala?

It is a dry spice blend used while making the tomato-and-timur dipping achar served with momo.

Is it a ready-made achar?

No. The masala is an ingredient for preparing the achar; it is not a ready-to-eat sauce.

Is it used in momo filling?

No. It is intended for momo dipping achar, not the filling inside momo.

Can I buy it now?

Commercial details are not approved yet. The product is currently being tested in Birendranagar.

How can I join testing?

Send Avaru a WhatsApp message. We will let you know whether the current testing round is relevant to you.
